dropped.6: SessionEvent and SessionEventBody left @alexkroman1/aai/protocol for the root barrel, where the new aai:events capability owns them (on /protocol they were owned by nothing and hashed in full by every capability that reached them). This epoch rollup imports them from /protocol, so it no longer compiles, and neither does a host that wrote against this surface importing either name from there: import them from @alexkroman1/aai. Nothing about this capability own signatures changed. Also: The simulated caller and the judge (simulateCall, judgeCall, their types, EvalSimulation*) moved to /eval/simulate as the eval-simulate capability, and expectCalled/lastToolResultIn to the eval-assert capability; EvalTestContext/EvalTextTestContext no longer carry simulate()/judge(), EvalCaseOptions no longer carries stubCaller/stubJudge, and the suite options no longer carry callerLlm/judgeLlm. An epoch-6 case destructuring simulate/judge, or importing those names from /eval, no longer compiles.

dropped.1: RuntimeOptions.generate, which this epoch's frozen starter passes, is no longer a RuntimeOptions member: it moved to the host-only HostRuntimeOptions (a relative import from the eval harness), so the starter no longer compiles.
dropped.2: RuntimeOptions.generate, which this epoch's frozen starter passes, is no longer a RuntimeOptions member: it moved to the host-only HostRuntimeOptions (a relative import from the eval harness), so the starter no longer compiles.
dropped.3: Epoch 3's RuntimeOptions still carried generate, which moved to the host-only HostRuntimeOptions, so an epoch-3 host passing it no longer compiles; and the names its frozen starter did not exercise were covered only by the v1/v2 starters, which were dropped for the same move.
dropped.4: Runtime is SEALED (a type-only runtimeBrand only createRuntime mints) and Runtime.connect(sink, options) became the free function connectSession(runtime, sink, options); RuntimeOptions.generate moved to the host-only HostRuntimeOptions behind a relative import. An epoch-4 caller of runtime.connect, or a hand-written Runtime, no longer compiles.

Session tickets moved to the /auth subpath (auth capability): createSessionToken, verifySessionToken, the three SESSION_* constants and the ticket types are no longer on the root barrel, and the servers' auth option takes an opaque SessionAuth from createSessionAuth() instead of a SessionAuthOptions literal. An epoch-4 server passing auth: { secret } no longer compiles.
